status: Protocol proposal, data not frozen, not runnable GPU authorization
dataset: MATH training,100 new proposed unique questions
comparison_scope: Same questions, seed, fit, model, grader, prompt and runtime across all4arms. No frozen historical tests rerun or substituted as current controls.
primary: RCscaled vsRC14 andRCconstant on thinking and total tokens, withR as original control.

screen_rule.retain_only_if: Thinking and total token point estimates both lower than each of R,RC14,RCconstant; observed accuracy loss no more than2pp against R or RC14, and no net cap increase against these two references.
screen_rule.meaning: Screening rule only; point estimates meeting it do not establish noninferiority or improvement.
screen_rule.reject: Fails rule or offers no additional benefit over fixed weakening; preserve all outputs and do not tune on these100questions.

uncertainty.method: Resample paired question indices, keep all4arms aligned;20000bootstrap draws. Report95percent intervals for thinking/total token ratio of means and paired accuracy differences; also report flip counts and caps.
uncertainty.interpretation: 100questions may leave the2pp margin unresolved; use independent confirmation for a retained candidate, never claim noninferiority from observed loss alone.
uncertainty.multiple_comparisons: No strict synergy claim. Screen contrasts are exploratory; any confirmatory endpoints/multiplicity treatment must be fixed separately.

correctness_policy: Use existing author grader and same extraction; retain errors,caps,and grading failures explicitly. Do not turn empty extraction into correct.
cost: No extra probes/forwards from method. Runtime profile, hard ceilings and execution commands still need to be fixed beforeGPU; no timing promise from512-token engineering speed.
next_required: Remote/local data ledger reconciliation, preserve existing200confirmation reservation.
